def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]

    # The isolated colored cells outside the framed picture indicate a
    # permutation of the non-background colors. Apply that permutation to
    # the picture, matching each outside color to the corresponding
    # in-picture color.
    outside = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1) and grid[r][c] != 0:
                outside.setdefault(grid[r][c], []).append((r, c))

    # In the framed picture, preserve the drawing and its layout.
    # External markers are used as color substitutions when their colors
    # also occur within the frame.
    present = {v for row in out for v in row}
    colors = sorted(present - {0, 1})
    extcolors = sorted(outside)
    if len(colors) == len(extcolors):
        mapping = dict(zip(colors, extcolors))
        out = [[mapping.get(v, v) if v not in (0, 1) else v for v in row] for row in out]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in ones), max(r for r, c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in ones), max(c for r, c in ones)
    picture = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]

    # The outside markers specify colors to exchange in the framed pattern.
    outside = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1) and grid[r][c] != 0:
                outside[grid[r][c]] = (r, c)

    # Exchange the two colors whose external markers are farthest apart.
    colors = list(outside)
    if len(colors) >= 2:

        picture = [[b if v == a else a if v == b else v for v in row]
                   for row in picture]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    pic = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    # Transpose the framed image and exchange the colors of its corner markers.
    out = [list(row) for row in zip(*pic)]
    special = [v for v in (2, 3, 4, 5, 8) if any(v in row for row in pic)]
    if len(special) >= 2:
        a, b = special[0], special[1]
        out = [[b if x == a else a if x == b else x for x in row] for row in out]
    return out
